title: 韦克斯穆尔媒体 om 叙事清除
instruction:
您是拉克兰·谢里丹 (Lachlan Sheridan)，一位房地产经纪人，负责韦克斯穆尔媒体 (Wexmoor Media) 前摄影棚和后期制作设施的发行备忘录中的市场和定位叙述。 Beatriz Chakraborty 打算在三周内向买家名单发布备忘录，而 Yusuf Escamilla 需要一个不需要另一轮实质性起草就能清除的版本。该房产的出售是由 Wexmoor Media 对主要舞台区域进行短期回租，因此这不是一个常规的空置工作室故事：根据目前文件中的交易假设，租约将在成交后八个月到期。已经熟悉这一机会的买家可能知道这段历史，但备忘录对于任何接收者来说都必须独立，不能依赖于私人谈话或假定的知识。叙述仍然需要为持续的媒体使用和其他可支持的适应性用途提供可信的案例，而不将物理特征、可比活动、规划指定或未来的租赁事件转变为有关需求、价值、批准、租金、转换成本或时间的承诺。
只在`Wexmoor_narrative_clearance_packet.docx`工作。它包含当前草案、公司的广告和披露控制、为本次任务提供的弗林特里奇管理局材料、批准的财产事实和交易假设、可比财产支持，以及根据优素福、比阿特丽斯、耶琳娜·哈夫利切克和易卜拉欣·英格拉姆的电子邮件和会议记录汇总的审查和变更记录。将其视为完整的清关记录；请勿添加市场统计数据、规划解释、租户意图、买家反应或记忆或外部研究中的其他事实。该数据包反映了多轮审查，而不是彻底重写，并且一些早期的语言仍然保留在草案中，即使后来的评论或改变的事实影响了它。重要的是整个数据包所代表的当前批准状态，包括各个条目记录的状态和异常信息。
请在数据包中指定的标题下给我一份精美的发行备忘录替换部分。可发表的叙述应在900和1,200字之间，不包括下面描述的内部许可说明。它应该被解读为已完成的主要级别的发行副本，而不是响应矩阵、法律备忘录、年表或草稿的轻微编辑版本。读者应该了解该房产是什么、其相关的生产和后期生产属性、当前占用和翻转时间、提供的规划背景以及支持定位论证的证据，而无需查阅底层数据包。有选择性地使用可比较的证据来保持叙述的进展，但要根据所提供的控制所需的水平来识别和归因它。保持整个部分中每个数字、日期、定义术语、属性描述、规划特征、交易假设和可比参考的一致。
展期必须以合理的买家在阅读叙述时会注意到的方式进行披露，而不暗示该房产目前空置、立即可用、肯定要更新或肯定会按假定的时间表可用。清理记录允许两种处理方式：将回租和展期整合到主要定位讨论中，或者在同一叙述中为其提供独特的占用和展期通道。两者都可以，而且我不希望两者都只是为了对冲。选择产生最清晰的可发布部分的处理方式。在任何一种情况下，将当前事实与假设的结束场景区分开来，并将适应性使用讨论保留在数据包中实际支持的用途、物证和批准资格内。请勿说或暗示弗林特里奇管理局已经批准了其未批准的转换，类似交易确定了该财产的未来结果，或者 Wexmoor Media 做出了未记录在批准事实中的更新、扩张、离开或运营承诺。
在可发布部分之后，开始一个单独的最终页面，标题为`Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication`。用不超过 150 的话，告诉 Yusuf 您选择了两种允许的展期处理中的哪一种，确定用于叙述的截止日期，并确认该部分反映了当前的审核记录以及提供的广告和披露控制。此注释仅供清关之用，并且必须在视觉和文字上与发售副本分开；不要在可发布的叙述中放置起草评论、来源引用、更改 ID、控制注释或内部审议。该说明不应介绍新的事实或试图弥补叙述中的遗漏——发行副本本身必须包含其定位和披露所需的所有事实。

返回一份专业格式的 Word 文档，其名称完全为 `Wexmoor_OM_narrative_final.docx`。使用该文件名将其写入您启动的工作目录的顶层。它应该为优素福的法律审查做好准备，并为比阿特丽斯将可发布的部分放入发行备忘录中而无需进行实质性重写。请勿返回 PDF、带标记的草稿、评论日志或任何其他文件。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：
- `references/Wexmoor_narrative_clearance_packet.docx` — 完整的源数据包，包含当前的叙述草案、批准的财产和交易事实、提供的规划材料、可比财产支持、广告和披露控制以及审查和变更记录。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Wexmoor_OM_narrative_final.docx` — 可发布的发行备忘录、市场和定位叙述，后附单独的内部许可说明。 （将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；使用所需的确切文件名。；可发布的叙述必须是900–1,200字，不包括内部许可说明。；内部许可说明必须在单独的最后一页上开始，使用确切的标题`Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication`，并且包含不超过150字。；仅使用事实、假设、控制、计划文本、可比较和审查所提供的数据包中包含的结果。；请勿在可发布的叙述中包含跟踪的更改、起草评论、控制注释、更改 ID 或源引用。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

Wexmoor Media | Narrative Clearance Packet
Offering memorandum working record | prepared for internal review | 18 September 2026
This packet is the complete supplied record for revision of the offering memorandum narrative. It combines the current draft, approved facts, supplied authority material, comparable support, and review correspondence distilled into the change register below. No external market research or authority interpretation is included or required.
Release Instruction
Publish the replacement section under the exact heading: Market & Positioning Narrative. The publishable section is to stand alone and may not include source citations, change identifiers, review commentary, or internal discussion. A separate final page must use the exact heading: Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication.
Current approved as-of date: 18 September 2026. This date governs the final review state.
Workflow Legend
The opening draft and earliest approved fact records are the starting state. Change ID is the de-duplication key for the review register: retain the latest effective entry for a Change ID. The latest approved row for a Fact Key controls in the fact schedule. For comparable records, Comp Key is the de-duplication key and the latest effective row controls. Final disposition determines whether a record is usable. In every table, row-level Notes override a conflicting main-column value. Dates may appear in ISO and slash formats; where a Notes cell resolves an otherwise ambiguous date, use that stated interpretation.
Review dispositions: Apply means the request belongs in the final published narrative; Rejected, Withdrawn, Superseded, and Internal only do not create publishable claims. One applied review item permits either an integrated leaseback disclosure or a distinct occupancy-and-rollover passage within the narrative. Select one treatment only and identify it in the internal clearance note.
Advertising and Disclosure Controls
Use only supplied, current approved facts. A physical description may state an existing attribute, but may not certify performance, code compliance, fitness, future condition, or suitability for a buyer’s use unless the supplied record does so.
State a known occupancy event in a manner a reasonable principal will notice. A modeled or assumed closing must be labeled as an assumption. Do not call leased space vacant, immediately available, or available after an expiration unless the supplied record supports that conclusion.
Planning language must use the supplied designation. Describe only listed permitted uses as permitted. A conditional, discretionary, or approval-dependent use must be qualified at the point of discussion; do not imply an approval, entitlement, or conversion that the authority has not approved.
Comparable activity is historical context, not a forecast. When used, identify the comparable property or approved descriptor, location, transaction type and status, relevant timing, and source basis in readable narrative form. Do not use an excluded, withdrawn, superseded, or non-comparable record.
Avoid superlatives, projections, assurances about value, rent, demand, buyer response, construction cost, conversion scope, delivery timing, return, approvals, or tenant intentions. The memorandum must stand on its own and may not rely on buyer-list conversations, private reactions, or presumed knowledge.

Flintridge Authority has not reviewed or approved a conversion, change of use, entitlement, occupancy classification, parking determination, or building-code compliance for the property.

Initial Draft Narrative (superseded working copy)
Wexmoor Media’s best-in-class 83,640 square foot studio campus presents an immediate vacant delivery opportunity in Flintridge’s premier media corridor. With four turnkey sound stages, abundant power, and a fully entitled path to creative office or training use, the property is positioned to capture exceptional tenant demand and future appreciation. Buyers already familiar with Wexmoor’s planned departure know the principal stage will be open at closing. Recent activity at Marlow Content Campus proves this property can command a premium outcome. Wexmoor is expected to renew as production expands, providing dependable income while an owner prepares a conversion.

Market & Positioning Narrative
Wexmoor Media former soundstage and post-production facility
Wexmoor Media offers a former soundstage and post-production facility at 7300 North Corbin Avenue in Flintridge, California. The property comprises approximately 84,120 square feet on 4.31 acres in the Flintridge industrial district. Vehicular ingress is from North Corbin Avenue, with a service connection reaching West Dorsey Road. This location and access pattern support a campus-style operating profile while leaving the purchaser to evaluate circulation, operations, and any future changes through its own diligence.
The production core consists of two sound stages and one production support volume. Stage A contains approximately 18,500 square feet with a 32-foot clear height, acoustically treated wall assemblies, and one grade-level loading door. Stage B contains approximately 14,300 square feet with a 28-foot clear height and acoustically treated wall assemblies. The 7,200-square-foot production support volume includes a scene shop, makeup and wardrobe area, and one dock-high loading door. These are existing physical attributes; the supplied record does not provide an acoustic certification, operating-performance guarantee, or representation that the spaces meet a future user’s particular requirements.
The former facility configuration also includes editorial rooms, color and sound suites, equipment rooms, production offices, and conference rooms. A 2,000-amp, 480/277-volt electrical service is identified at the main switchgear. The site has 182 existing striped parking spaces, two gated driveways, and truck circulation along the west elevation. The parking count and electrical description are factual observations only: the supplied record does not conclude that parking is code-compliant or sufficient, or that the electrical service is suitable for a proposed operation. Existing loading and circulation should likewise be assessed against a purchaser’s intended use.
The parcel is designated MPS-2 — Media Production and Services District. The Flintridge Authority excerpt supplied for this assignment identifies motion-picture, television, and streaming-production stages; post-production, sound editing, and media-production offices; rehearsal and pre-production spaces ancillary to media production; and equipment storage and servicing ancillary to a permitted media-production use as permitted in MPS-2. The excerpt is planning context, not a zoning verification, entitlement, or project approval. Flintridge Authority has not reviewed or approved a conversion, change of use, occupancy classification, parking determination, or building-code compliance for this property.
The same excerpt states that general office not ancillary to media production and vocational or production-training facilities may be considered only with a Conditional Use Permit and any other applicable approvals. Those approval-dependent uses are therefore considerations for a prospective purchaser, not current entitlements. Any adaptive-use analysis would also need to address the existing configuration, building systems, access, parking, and the approvals applicable to the proposed program. No conversion cost, construction scope, delivery timing, future rent, future value, or investment return is represented.
Current Occupancy and Rollover
Wexmoor Media is the current leaseback tenant for Stage A, the principal sound stage area. The offering is structured as a sale with that leaseback, so the property is not presently vacant and Stage A is not represented as immediately available. Based on the transaction assumptions in the supplied record, an assumed closing on 15 October 2026 would precede the contractual lease expiration on 15 June 2027 by approximately eight months. The closing date is an assumption, not a completed or guaranteed event. The lease record states that there are no renewal options and that Wexmoor Media has provided no written renewal, extension, expansion, departure, or other operational commitment. The known expiration date does not establish the condition, possession, or availability of Stage A after expiration; those matters remain subject to the lease, any subsequent agreement, and the facts then existing.
Within those limits, the physical record supports a credible continued-media-use positioning. The two sound stages, acoustically treated assemblies, production support volume, post-production rooms, editing and sound suites, loading points, truck circulation, and electrical service are all existing components associated with the former production program. MPS-2 also expressly identifies production, post-production, ancillary media offices, rehearsal and pre-production, and ancillary equipment support as permitted categories. The combination describes what the property is and the planning context supplied for it; it does not predict tenant demand, absorption, rent, value, or the length of time required to re-occupy any space.
The same base may be relevant to a purchaser considering a media-oriented operation or an approval-dependent program that uses portions of the existing office and support areas. General office not ancillary to media production and production-training uses require a Conditional Use Permit and other applicable approvals under the supplied Authority excerpt. Prospective purchasers should confirm the proposed use, physical changes, parking and loading implications, and all applicable approvals with the Authority and their advisers. The narrative does not state that any adaptive conversion has been approved or that the existing improvements are ready for a new use.
Historical activity at other properties provides context for the range of media-related real estate transactions without establishing an outcome for Wexmoor Media. County recorder transfer-index information identifies Meridian Works, 4200 Meridian Avenue, Easton, as a sale that closed on 8 April 2025; the record reports a 71,600-square-foot property and a $20,900,000 transfer price. Broker-confirmed executed-lease information identifies Vista Harbor Studios, 908 Harbor View Boulevard, Larkspur, as a lease executed on 12 November 2025 involving a 62,400-square-foot facility and 33,000 square feet leased. These records are historical reference points with different locations, transaction types, physical programs, and timing. They are not appraisals, forecasts, or promises of price, rent, demand, buyer response, or timing for the subject property.
The property is therefore presented as an existing, media-oriented campus with a defined leaseback and a known contractual rollover date under the stated closing assumption. Its stage, post-production, support, access, loading, and electrical attributes may inform a purchaser’s evaluation of continued media use; its MPS-2 context identifies permitted media categories and places any non-ancillary office or training concept behind a Conditional Use Permit and other applicable approvals. The offering should be read with the lease and the purchaser’s independent diligence, including confirmation of measurements, systems, parking, circulation, planning, and the condition and availability of space after the lease expires.

Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication
I chose the distinct occupancy-and-rollover passage within the publishable narrative. The narrative uses the approved as-of date of 18 September 2026 and treats 15 October 2026 as an assumed closing date, with the 15 June 2027 lease expiration stated as the contractual date. It reflects the current reconciled review record, including the controlling fact and comparable rows, and applies the supplied advertising and disclosure controls. This is a bounded clearance confirmation for Yusuf Escamilla’s review, not a broader legal opinion or a guarantee of market, authority, tenant, or transaction outcomes.

original.criterion: The document renders without clipped text, overlapping elements, orphaned headings, blank unintended pages, or other defects that impede review.
original.evidence: Rendered pages of the submitted document.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX to PDF or page images and inspect every page.

criteria.description: 可发布部分使用源数据包中指定的确切发行备忘录标题。
criteria.evidence: 提交文档中的标题与数据包的指定标题进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 匹配措辞和大小写；细微的风格差异是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The publishable section uses the exact offering-memorandum heading designated in the source packet.
original.evidence: Heading in the submitted document compared with the packet’s designated heading.
original.grader_hint: Match wording and capitalization; minor style differences are acceptable.

criteria.description: 可出版的叙述包含 900–1,200 个单词，对于连字或自动字数处理方面的差异，容忍 ±10 个单词。
criteria.evidence: 可发布标题和内部许可说明之间的文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 计数时排除标题和内部清关单。

original.criterion: The publishable narrative contains 900–1,200 words, with a tolerance of ±10 words for differences in hyphenation or automated word-count treatment.
original.evidence: Text between the publishable heading and the internal clearance note.
original.grader_hint: Exclude headings and the internal clearance note when counting.

criteria.description: 该文档包含确切的标题`Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication`。
criteria.evidence: 最终页标题。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查确切的文本，仅允许对破折号进行印刷标准化。

original.criterion: The document contains the exact heading `Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication`.
original.evidence: Final-page heading.
original.grader_hint: Check for the exact text, allowing typographic normalization of the dash only.

criteria.description: 内部许可说明从单独的最后一页开始，并且明确地位于可发布的发行副本之外。
criteria.evidence: 渲染文档中的分页和视觉分离。
criteria.grader_hint: 注释必须在分页之后开始，并且其后不得有可发表的叙述。

original.criterion: The internal clearance note starts on a separate final page and is unmistakably outside the publishable offering copy.
original.evidence: Pagination and visual separation in the rendered document.
original.grader_hint: The note must begin after a page break and no publishable narrative may follow it.

criteria.description: 内部通关单包含不超过150个字，自动计数差异的容差为+5个字。
criteria.evidence: 内部注释标题后面的文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 从计数中排除标题本身。

original.criterion: The internal clearance note contains no more than 150 words, with a tolerance of +5 words for automated counting differences.
original.evidence: Text following the internal-note heading.
original.grader_hint: Exclude the heading itself from the count.

criteria.description: 内部许可说明明确指出了当前审查记录允许的两种展期处理方法中的一种，并且已发布的叙述实施了该处理方法。
criteria.evidence: 许可说明、叙述结构和当前评论条目允许替代方案。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受综合披露或单独的占用和翻转通道。如果注释声称一种方法，而叙述使用另一种方法或不加区别地重复两种方法，则不要奖励。

original.criterion: The internal clearance note explicitly identifies exactly one of the two rollover treatments permitted by the current review record, and the published narrative implements that treatment.
original.evidence: Clearance note, narrative structure, and current review entry allowing the alternatives.
original.grader_hint: Accept either integrated disclosure or a distinct occupancy-and-rollover passage. Do not award if the note claims one approach while the narrative uses the other or indiscriminately duplicates both.

criteria.description: 内部许可说明规定了管理最终来源状态的相同批准日期。
criteria.evidence: 记录状态重放后与控制数据包条目进行比较的日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用数据包规定的记录密钥、计时规则、状态和注释覆盖来解析当前状态。

original.criterion: The internal clearance note states the same approved as-of date that governs the final source state.
original.evidence: Note date compared with the controlling packet entry after state replay.
original.grader_hint: Resolve the current state using the packet’s stated record key, timing rule, statuses, and notes overrides.

criteria.description: 内部许可说明确认了当前审查记录以及所提供的广告和披露控制措施的应用，但没有提出更广泛的法律意见。
criteria.evidence: 内部间隙注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找有限制的清关确认，而不是包装之外的法律合规性或市场准确性的保证。

original.criterion: The internal clearance note confirms application of both the current review record and the supplied advertising and disclosure controls without asserting a broader legal opinion.
original.evidence: Internal clearance note.
original.grader_hint: Look for a bounded clearance confirmation, not a guarantee of legal compliance or market accuracy beyond the packet.

criteria.description: 该叙述使用批准的最终财产描述准确地识别了资产当前和以前的生产相关特征。
criteria.evidence: 叙述与当前批准的财产事实进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 描述必须反映最终状态而不是被取代的草案措辞。

original.criterion: The narrative accurately identifies the asset’s current and former production-related character using the approved final property description.
original.evidence: Narrative compared with the current approved property facts.
original.grader_hint: The description must reflect the final state rather than superseded draft wording.

criteria.description: 该叙述提供了批准的位置和访问上下文，而没有将其扩展到不受支持的邻近或旅行时间声明。
criteria.evidence: 地点语言与批准的事实时间表进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 数据包必须支持所有规定的地理关系。

original.criterion: The narrative gives the approved location and access context without expanding it into unsupported proximity or travel-time claims.
original.evidence: Location language compared with the approved fact schedule.
original.grader_hint: All stated geographic relationships must be supported by the packet.

criteria.description: 叙述中注明的总建筑面积等于数据包中最终批准的总建筑面积，在±1平方英尺内。
criteria.evidence: 叙述面积图和最终有效事实记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 在应用当前状态和注释规则后使用修订后的值，而不是被取代的草案数字。

original.criterion: The gross building area stated in the narrative equals the final approved gross building area in the packet, within ±1 square foot.
original.evidence: Narrative area figure and final effective fact record.
original.grader_hint: Use the post-revision value after applying current-status and notes rules, not the superseded draft figure.

criteria.description: 叙述中所述的任何场地面积数字等于最终批准的场地面积，在±0.01英亩范围内。
criteria.evidence: 叙述和批准的事实时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果叙述合理地省略了场地区域，则仅当数据包未将其指定为定位部分的材料时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: Any site-area figure stated in the narrative equals the final approved site area, within ±0.01 acre.
original.evidence: Narrative and approved fact schedule.
original.grader_hint: If the narrative reasonably omits site area, award only if the packet does not designate it as material to the positioning section.

criteria.description: 叙述说明了阶段或产量的正确数量和批准的特征。
criteria.evidence: 叙述与最终财产事实进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查计数和描述性术语；拒绝被取代的计数或不受支持的标签。

original.criterion: The narrative states the correct number and approved characterization of stages or production volumes.
original.evidence: Narrative compared with final property facts.
original.grader_hint: Check both count and descriptive terminology; reject superseded counts or unsupported labels.

criteria.description: 叙述中提到的生产空间特征，例如净高、负载、功率、声学处理或支撑空间，仅限于并与最终批准的事实一致。
criteria.evidence: 在叙述和最终事实表中提出主张。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查实际提到的每个功能；如果材料批准的生产功能被不受支持的功能替换，则不会获得积分。

original.criterion: Production-space features mentioned in the narrative, such as clear height, loading, power, acoustical treatment, or support space, are limited to and consistent with final approved facts.
original.evidence: Feature claims in the narrative and final fact schedule.
original.grader_hint: Check each feature actually mentioned; no credit if a material approved production feature is replaced by an unsupported one.

criteria.description: 后期制作和办公组件的描述与其批准的当前配置一致，并且未表示为经过认证的数据包不支持的用途。
criteria.evidence: 叙述性和经批准的空间描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 将现有配置与可能的重用区分开来。

original.criterion: The post-production and office components are described consistently with their approved present configuration and are not represented as certified for a use the packet does not support.
original.evidence: Narrative and approved space descriptions.
original.grader_hint: Distinguish existing configuration from possible reuse.

criteria.description: 停车、流通和装载声明反映了最终批准的事实，并在适用的情况下使用包所需的资格。
criteria.evidence: 叙述与当前的财产事实条目进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 在比较之前应用任何行级注释覆盖。

original.criterion: Parking, circulation, and loading statements reflect the final approved facts and use the packet’s required qualifications where applicable.
original.evidence: Narrative compared with the current property-fact entries.
original.grader_hint: Apply any row-level notes override before comparing.

criteria.description: 该叙述使用了数据包中提供的当前弗林特里奇管理局规划或分区名称。
criteria.evidence: 叙述和提供的权威材料。
criteria.grader_hint: 不接受被取代的名称、口语替代或更广泛的名称。

original.criterion: The narrative uses the exact current Flintridge Authority planning or zoning designation supplied in the packet.
original.evidence: Narrative and supplied authority material.
original.grader_hint: Do not accept a superseded designation, colloquial substitute, or broader designation.

criteria.description: 当前允许的用途是所提供的弗林特里奇管理局文本所标识的适用名称下允许的用途的子集。
criteria.evidence: 叙述性使用陈述和提供的计划文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较每项被描述为允许或可用的用途。

original.criterion: Uses described as currently permitted are a subset of the uses the supplied Flintridge Authority text identifies as permitted under the applicable designation.
original.evidence: Narrative use statements and supplied planning text.
original.grader_hint: Compare every use described as permitted or available as of right.

criteria.description: 根据所提供的权威文本，任何有条件的、酌情决定的或依赖批准的使用在讨论时都明确限定。
criteria.evidence: 叙述和计划控制摘录。
criteria.grader_hint: 其他地方的通用样板并不能解决不合格的使用声明。

original.criterion: Any conditional, discretionary, or approval-dependent use is clearly qualified at the point of discussion in accordance with the supplied authority text.
original.evidence: Narrative and planning-control excerpt.
original.grader_hint: Generic boilerplate elsewhere does not cure an unqualified use claim.

criteria.description: 该叙述并未声明或暗示弗林特里奇管理局已批准未在来源中显示的转换、权利或用途变更。
criteria.evidence: 叙述中所有权威和认可的语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估含义以及明确的主张，包括批准、有权、保证或按权利等词语。

original.criterion: The narrative does not state or imply that Flintridge Authority has approved a conversion, entitlement, or change of use not shown as approved in the source.
original.evidence: All authority and approval language in the narrative.
original.grader_hint: Assess implications as well as explicit claims, including words such as approved, entitled, assured, or by-right.

criteria.description: 该叙述将 Wexmoor Media 确定为当前回租租户，并描述了其占用空间或运营范围，与最终批准的租赁事实一致。
criteria.evidence: 入住讨论和当前交易事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 应用修改后的空间并使用事实而不是最初的草案。

original.criterion: The narrative identifies Wexmoor Media as the current leaseback tenant and describes its occupied space or operational scope consistently with the final approved lease facts.
original.evidence: Occupancy discussion and current transaction facts.
original.grader_hint: Apply revised space and use facts rather than the initial draft.

criteria.description: 规定的租赁到期日期与重播源记录后最终批准的租赁日期完全匹配。
criteria.evidence: 叙述日期和当前租赁事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用数据包的明确注释和工作流程约定来解决混合日期表示。

original.criterion: The stated lease-expiration date exactly matches the final approved lease date after the source record is replayed.
original.evidence: Narrative date and current lease fact.
original.grader_hint: Resolve mixed date representations using the packet’s explicit notes and workflow conventions.

criteria.description: 该叙述将截止日期确定为假设而非已完成或保证的事件，并使用最终批准的假设截止日期。
criteria.evidence: 叙述和当前交易假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查日期和条件框架。

original.criterion: The narrative identifies the closing date as an assumption rather than a completed or guaranteed event and uses the final approved assumed closing date.
original.evidence: Narrative and current transaction assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Check both the date and the conditional framing.

criteria.description: 假设交割和租赁到期之间的间隔等于从两个最终批准日期得出的间隔，在 ±3 日历日内，或者如果以月表示，则在 ±0.1 月内。
criteria.evidence: 叙述时间表和最终批准日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源日期计算。当与确切日期一致时，接受数据包支持的四舍五入月份描述。

original.criterion: The interval presented between the assumed closing and lease expiration equals the interval derived from the two final approved dates, within ±3 calendar days or, if expressed in months, ±0.1 month.
original.evidence: Narrative timeline and final approved dates.
original.grader_hint: Compute from the source dates. Accept the packet-supported rounded-month description when consistent with the exact dates.

criteria.description: 叙述准确地传达了最终批准的续订选项状态。
criteria.evidence: 叙述和租赁事实记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要从讨论或被取代的草案文本中推断选项。

original.criterion: The narrative accurately communicates the final approved renewal-option status.
original.evidence: Narrative and lease-fact record.
original.grader_hint: Do not infer options from discussions or superseded draft text.

criteria.description: 叙述准确地传达了数据包有关续订、延期、扩建、离开或其他租户讨论的当前状态，而不会将沉默或初步材料转化为承诺。
criteria.evidence: 租户意图语言和最终审查/事实状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用任何相关审阅记录的当前处置和注释字段。

original.criterion: The narrative accurately communicates the packet’s current state regarding renewal, extension, expansion, departure, or other tenant discussions, without turning silence or preliminary material into a commitment.
original.evidence: Tenant-intention language and final review/fact state.
original.grader_hint: Use the current disposition and notes fields for any related review records.

criteria.description: 回租和展期的披露足够突出和清晰，合理的委托人在阅读叙述时会注意到并理解它，而无需查阅租金清单。
criteria.evidence: 呈现的叙述中披露的位置、措辞和上下文。
criteria.grader_hint: 隐藏在密集的不相关段落中的披露、对灵活性的模糊提及或对内部注释的依赖不应获得满分。

original.criterion: The leaseback and rollover disclosure is sufficiently prominent and clear that a reasonable principal reading the narrative would notice and understand it without consulting the rent roll.
original.evidence: Placement, wording, and context of the disclosure in the rendered narrative.
original.grader_hint: Disclosure buried in a dense unrelated paragraph, vague references to flexibility, or reliance on the internal note should not earn full credit.

criteria.description: 该房产并未被描述为目前空置、完全可用或可在批准的回租仍然有效的情况下立即占有。
criteria.evidence: 整个叙述中的可用性和占用语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标题、说明文字、引述和正文（如果有）。

original.criterion: The property is not described as presently vacant, wholly available, or available for immediate possession while the approved leaseback remains in effect.
original.evidence: Availability and occupancy language throughout the narrative.
original.grader_hint: Check headlines, captions, pull quotes, and body copy if present.

criteria.description: 该叙述将已知的租赁到期事件与到期后空间的不确定条件、时间和可用性区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 展期和未来可用性措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 有效期可以作为事实陈述；除非包装支持，否则不得保证过期后的可用性或状况。

original.criterion: The narrative distinguishes the known lease-expiration event from the uncertain condition, timing, and availability of the space after expiration.
original.evidence: Rollover and future-availability wording.
original.grader_hint: The expiration date may be stated as a fact; post-expiration availability or condition must not be guaranteed unless the packet supports it.

criteria.description: 持续的媒体使用定位是由当前的物理事实和允许使用的材料支持的，而不是不受支持的需求、租金或吸收主张。
criteria.evidence: 媒体使用论证与财产事实、规划文本和控制进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估论证的既定基础，而不仅仅是结论听起来是否合理。

original.criterion: The continued media-use positioning is supported by current physical facts and permitted-use material rather than unsupported demand, rent, or absorption assertions.
original.evidence: Media-use argument compared with property facts, planning text, and controls.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate the stated basis for the argument, not merely whether the conclusion sounds plausible.

criteria.description: 叙述中提到的每项适应性再利用均得到所提供的财产或规划材料的支持，并具有任何所需的批准资格。
criteria.evidence: 适应性使用声明和提供的来源。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据数据包单独检查每个指定的用途。

original.criterion: Every adaptive reuse named in the narrative is supported by the supplied property or planning material and carries any required approval qualification.
original.evidence: Adaptive-use statements and supplied sources.
original.grader_hint: Check each named use individually against the packet.

criteria.description: 有关身体适宜性的陈述被视为现有属性或潜在考虑因素，并不保证未来用户的可行性。
criteria.evidence: 自适应重用和构建功能语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找不受支持的结论，例如交钥匙、易于转换或数据包无法证实的理想结论。

original.criterion: Statements about physical suitability are framed as existing attributes or potential considerations and do not guarantee feasibility for a future user.
original.evidence: Adaptive-reuse and building-feature language.
original.grader_hint: Look for unsupported conclusions such as turnkey, readily convertible, or ideal where the packet does not substantiate them.

criteria.description: 叙述中没有对转换成本、建设范围、交付时间、未来租金、未来价值或投资回报做出任何未经证实的断言。
criteria.evidence: 所有财务、构造和计时语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果合格的陈述引入了数据包中没有的数据或结论，则它们仍然不受支持。

original.criterion: The narrative makes no unsupported assertion about conversion cost, construction scope, delivery timing, future rent, future value, or investment return.
original.evidence: All financial, construction, and timing language.
original.grader_hint: Qualified statements remain unsupported if they introduce figures or conclusions absent from the packet.

criteria.description: 叙述中使用的可比记录对应于对数据包中明确说明的键进行重复数据删除之后的不同源记录。
criteria.evidence: 叙述中的可比参考文献和数据包的可比表。
criteria.grader_hint: 应用指定的键，以便重叠或重复的源行不会被计数或作为单独的证据呈现。

original.criterion: Comparable records used in the narrative correspond to distinct source records after de-duplication on the key explicitly stated in the packet.
original.evidence: Comparable references in the narrative and the packet’s comparable table.
original.grader_hint: Apply the stated key so overlapping or repeated source rows are not counted or presented as separate evidence.

criteria.description: 对于具有注释字段例外的可比较记录，叙述反映注释字段值或处置，而不是冲突的主列值。
criteria.evidence: 源中的可比较声明和行级注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 数据包指出行注释覆盖主要字段；检查受此类例外影响的每个引用的可比较对象。

original.criterion: For comparable records with a notes-field exception, the narrative reflects the notes-field value or disposition rather than the conflicting main-column value.
original.evidence: Comparable claims and row-level notes in the source.
original.grader_hint: The packet states that row notes override the main fields; check every cited comparable affected by such an exception.

criteria.description: 尽管源列中存在混合日期表示，但叙述中使用或描述的可比日期反映了源的预期日期。
criteria.evidence: 叙述计时语言和可比较的日期，包括具有其他不明确表示的行。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用来源的明确上下文或注释来澄清不明确的条目。

original.criterion: Comparable dates used or characterized in the narrative reflect the source’s intended dates despite the mixed date representations in the source column.
original.evidence: Narrative timing language and comparable dates, including the row with an otherwise ambiguous representation.
original.grader_hint: Use the source’s explicit contextual or notes clarification for the ambiguous entry.

criteria.description: 每个保留的可比资产均通过正确批准的财产名称或描述符、位置、交易类型和状态进行标识。
criteria.evidence: 叙述性可比较的参考文献和经协调的源记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查实际引用的每个可比较的完整属性集。

original.criterion: Each retained comparable is identified by the correct approved property name or descriptor, location, transaction type, and status.
original.evidence: Narrative comparable references and reconciled source records.
original.grader_hint: Check the full set of attributes for every comparable actually cited.

criteria.description: 叙述中包含的每个数字可比指标等于调节后的源值，在源值或显示的舍入单位（以较大者为准）的 ±1% 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 叙述和协调源行中的可比较指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 在比较之前应用重复数据删除和注释覆盖；仅评估叙述中包含的指标。

original.criterion: Every numerical comparable metric included in the narrative equals the reconciled source value, within ±1% of the source value or the displayed rounding unit, whichever is larger.
original.evidence: Comparable metrics in the narrative and reconciled source rows.
original.grader_hint: Apply de-duplication and notes overrides before comparing; evaluate only metrics the narrative includes.

criteria.description: 使用所提供的广告控制所需的基础和归因语言来归因可比较的证据。
criteria.evidence: 类似的讨论和广告控制文本。

source_artifact.purpose: Create one coherent internal clearance packet that can be read without external research and that contains the complete initial state, governing controls, supporting facts, and chronological revision events.
semantic_contents: An initial market and positioning narrative containing otherwise polished copy but also several statements that later approved facts or review dispositions require changing.

A short, genuine advertising and disclosure control excerpt governing factual support, attribution of comparables, treatment of assumptions, balanced disclosure of known occupancy events, planning and approval claims, superlatives, projections, and confidential stakeholder knowledge.
A Flintridge Authority excerpt giving the applicable planning designation, permitted uses, approval-dependent uses, and the limits of any authority position supplied for the property.

An approved property and transaction fact schedule covering location, building and site measurements, production and post-production features, parking and access, occupancy, the sale-and-leaseback structure, assumed closing date, lease expiration, renewal options, and the bounded state of tenant discussions.

A comparable-property schedule providing enough historical evidence to support a restrained positioning argument, with source attribution fields, transaction or listing status, relevant metrics, and dates.

A chronological review and change register derived from emails, meeting notes, and stakeholder feedback. Each entry has a stated unique Change ID, event date, disposition, affected topic, requested outcome, and notes field.

A workflow legend that is plausible as part of the firm’s review record and explicitly states that Change ID is the de-duplication key, the latest effective entry for a Change ID controls, final dispositions determine whether a change is applied, and row-level Notes override conflicting main-column fields.

A current approved as-of date and an explicit review entry allowing either an integrated rollover disclosure or a distinct occupancy-and-rollover passage, provided only one treatment is chosen and identified in the internal clearance note.
The exact publishable section heading and exact internal-note heading required from the solver.

state_replay.opening_state: The initial draft and the earliest approved fact records are the opening state.
state_replay.events: Apply review and changed-fact entries in effective chronological order after reconciling duplicate Change IDs. For each Change ID retain the controlling latest entry, then apply the disposition and any Notes override.
state_replay.final_state: The gold narrative may use only final approved facts, eligible reconciled comparables, current planning language, and review outcomes marked for application. Rejected, withdrawn, superseded, excluded, or internal-only material is not publishable unless the source explicitly permits a bounded statement in the internal clearance note.
state_replay.acceptable_branch: The final review state expressly permits two disclosure structures. The gold set therefore includes both an integrated treatment and a distinct in-narrative occupancy-and-rollover passage. The solver must choose one, implement it coherently, and identify it in the clearance note.

seeded_layout_defects.duplicate_or_overlapping_rows: Include duplicate or overlapping review or comparable rows sharing a Change ID or comparable key explicitly identified in the source legend. At least one duplicated key must have an updated controlling record so that blindly counting or copying all rows creates a false extra fact or stale conclusion.
seeded_layout_defects.mixed_date_representations: Use both ISO dates and slash-form dates in the same event-date or comparable-date column. Include one slash-form date that is ambiguous on its face; an entry-level Notes statement must unambiguously identify the intended calendar date.
seeded_layout_defects.notes_overrides: Include several rows where Notes explicitly replace a main-column status, metric, date interpretation, or disposition. At least one override must affect comparable eligibility and at least one must affect a changed property, lease, or review fact.
seeded_layout_defects.exclude_other_standard_defects: Do not add missing required values, formula errors, hidden sheets, image-only facts, conflicting source documents, unit mismatches, zero denominators, unexplained codes, broken links, truncated text, shifted headers, or unrelated side tables.

fact_relationships_for_gold: The final gross building area is the controlling approved area after event replay; all narrative area references must equal it.

The final site area, stage count, stage characteristics, office and post-production descriptions, parking, loading, power, access, and other physical attributes come from the controlling approved fact records after Notes overrides.

The assumed closing date and lease-expiration date are controlling source facts. The rollover interval is calculated directly from those dates; the source values should yield approximately eight months while allowing an exact calendar derivation.

The assumed closing date must be described as an assumption. Lease expiration may be stated as a known contractual date, while post-expiration possession, condition, renewal, and availability remain limited to what the final lease facts support.

Renewal options and the state of tenant discussions are taken only from the controlling lease facts and review entries. Seed an unsupported tenant-intention statement in the initial draft and have the final review state require its removal.

Permitted-use statements must be subsets of the supplied Flintridge Authority excerpt. Conditional or discretionary uses require the qualification stated by that excerpt. No source fact should support a claim that an unapproved conversion has already been approved.
Each usable comparable is obtained by de-duplicating on the source-stated key, selecting the controlling record, applying Notes overrides, and filtering to the final eligible status.
Every comparable identity, location, transaction type, status, metric, date, and attribution in the gold narrative is copied or faithfully paraphrased from the reconciled retained record.
Comparable synthesis may support historical context or positioning but cannot be transformed into a forecast of future rent, value, demand, timing, return, or buyer behavior.
The approved as-of date is the final effective review date identified by the packet and must appear in the clearance note.

Every final-disposition Apply entry must be reflected in the appropriate portion of the document. Rejected, withdrawn, superseded, excluded, and internal-only entries must not become publishable assertions.

Seed initial-draft superlatives, immediate-availability wording, an overbroad approval claim, a projection-like comparable conclusion, a presumed-buyer-knowledge statement, and at least one superseded measurement. The final review state and controls deterministically require correction or removal.
The publishable narrative must include the material rollover, occupancy, planning, property, and comparable facts without requiring the clearance note to cure an omission.

The internal clearance note identifies the selected authorized disclosure structure, the final as-of date, and application of the current review record and controls. It introduces no substantive property or market fact.

original_instruction:
You are Lachlan Sheridan, the real estate broker responsible for the market and positioning narrative in the offering memorandum for Wexmoor Media’s former soundstage and post-production facility. Beatriz Chakraborty intends to release the memorandum to the buyer list in three weeks, and Yusuf Escamilla needs a version he can clear without another substantive drafting round. The property is being sold with a short Wexmoor Media leaseback of the principal stage area, so this is not a routine vacant-studio story: under the transaction assumptions now in the file, the lease expires eight months after closing. The buyers already familiar with the opportunity may know that history, but the memorandum must stand on its own for any recipient and cannot depend on private conversations or presumed knowledge. The narrative still needs to make a credible case for continued media use and other supportable adaptive uses without turning physical characteristics, comparable activity, planning designations, or a future lease event into promises about demand, value, approvals, rent, conversion cost, or timing.

Work only from `Wexmoor_narrative_clearance_packet.docx`. It contains the current draft, the firm’s advertising and disclosure controls, the Flintridge Authority material supplied for this assignment, the approved property facts and transaction assumptions, the comparable-property support, and the review and change record assembled from Yusuf’s, Beatriz’s, Jelena Havlicek’s, and Ibrahim Ingram’s emails and meeting notes. Treat it as the complete clearance record; do not add market statistics, planning interpretations, tenant intentions, buyer reactions, or other facts from memory or outside research. The packet reflects several rounds of review rather than a clean rewrite, and some early language remains in the draft even though later comments or changed facts affect it. What matters is the current approved state represented by the packet as a whole, including the status and exception information recorded with individual entries.

Give me a polished replacement section for the offering memorandum under the heading specified in the packet. The publishable narrative should be between 900 and 1,200 words, excluding the internal clearance note described below. It should read as finished principal-level offering copy, not as a response matrix, legal memorandum, chronology, or lightly edited version of the draft. A reader should understand what the property is, its relevant production and post-production attributes, the current occupancy and rollover timing, the supplied planning context, and the evidence supporting the positioning argument without having to consult the underlying packet. Use comparable evidence selectively enough to keep the narrative moving, but identify and attribute it at the level required by the supplied controls. Keep every number, date, defined term, property description, planning characterization, transaction assumption, and comparable reference consistent across the section.

The rollover must be disclosed in a way a reasonable buyer will notice while reading the narrative, without suggesting that the premises are presently vacant, immediately available, certain to be renewed, or certain to become available on the assumed schedule. The clearance record permits two treatments: integrating the leaseback and rollover into the main positioning discussion, or giving it a distinct occupancy-and-rollover passage within the same narrative. Either can work, and I do not want both merely to hedge. Choose the treatment that produces the clearest publishable section. In either case, distinguish current facts from the assumed closing scenario and keep the adaptive-use discussion within the uses, physical evidence, and approval qualifications actually supported in the packet. Do not say or imply that Flintridge Authority has approved a conversion it has not approved, that comparable transactions establish a future result for this property, or that Wexmoor Media has made a renewal, expansion, departure, or operational commitment not recorded in the approved facts.

After the publishable section, start a separate final page headed `Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication`. In no more than 150 words, tell Yusuf which of the two permitted rollover treatments you chose, identify the as-of date used for the narrative, and confirm that the section reflects the current review record and the supplied advertising and disclosure controls. This note is for clearance only and must be visually and textually separate from the offering copy; do not place drafting comments, source citations, change IDs, control annotations, or internal deliberations inside the publishable narrative. The note should not introduce new facts or try to cure an omission in the narrative—the offering copy itself must contain every fact needed for its positioning and disclosure.

Return one professionally formatted Word document named exactly `Wexmoor_OM_narrative_final.docx`. Write it into the top level of the working directory you start in, using exactly that filename. It should be ready for Yusuf’s legal review and for Beatriz to place the publishable section into the offering memorandum without substantive rewriting. Do not return a PDF, a marked-up draft, a comment log, or any additional file.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

(Place the file at the top level of the working directory.; Use the exact required filename.; The publishable narrative must be 900–1,200 words, excluding the internal clearance note.; The internal clearance note must begin on a separate final page, use the exact heading `Internal Clearance Note — Not for Publication`, and contain no more than 150 words.; Use only facts, assumptions, controls, planning text, comparables, and review outcomes contained in the supplied packet.; Do not include tracked changes, drafting comments, control annotations, change IDs, or source citations in the publishable narrative.)
